extDescription.message: Set the volume of each tab separately, with an optional boost up to 200%.

cmdVolumeUp.message: Raise the current tab volume by 10%

cmdVolumeDown.message: Lower the current tab volume by 10%

cmdToggleMute.message: Mute or unmute the current tab

emptyPlaying.message: No other tab is playing audio

restricted.message: The browser doesn’t allow extensions to change the volume of this page.

notInvoked.message: Allow free control to adjust this tab from here.

boostLimited.message: This site can’t go above 100% from here. Open the extension on this tab to boost it.

noMedia.message: No video or audio found on this page. If nothing changes, open the extension on this tab.

settingsFreeHint.message: Adjusts the video and audio of any tab from here. The browser will ask for access to websites; nothing is read or sent anywhere.

captureFailed.message: Couldn’t control this tab’s audio. Try again.

settingsBoostHint.message: Lets you go up to 200%. High levels can distort audio and harm your hearing or speakers.

settingsBadgeHint.message: Displays the tab’s volume on the toolbar icon when it isn’t 100%.

settingsShortcutsHint.message: Raise, lower or mute the current tab without opening the extension.

howItWorksHint.message: Tabs where you open the extension are captured: while they aren’t at 100%, the browser shows them as shared. With free control, other tabs are adjusted through their video and audio, without that indicator.
